summary: Comprehensive testing of Login Page (pull-cord animation, futuristic theme), Admin Dashboard (all tabs), and New Sample Request from Request Detail. All 16 backend tests pass. All frontend features working correctly.

New Sample button appears in Request Detail sidebar for Buyer/Capex Head roles, opens dialog with material description and quantity fields.
